known_text: I didn't do much on Sunday.

use.known: I didn't do much on Sunday because I was too tired.
use.target: 我星期天没做什么因为我太累了。

use.known: She asked if I want to do something with her this Sunday.
use.target: 她问我是不是想这个星期天和她做东西。

use.known: If I have time on Sunday, I will try to do more work.
use.target: 如果我星期天有时间，我会试着做更多工作。

use.known: I hope I can do something interesting this weekend.
use.target: 我希望我这个周末可以做一些有意思的东西。

use.known: Everyone said they didn't see me doing much on Sunday.
use.target: 大家都说他们星期天没见我做什么。

use.known: Did anyone ask you what I did on Sunday last week?
use.target: 有人问你我上星期天做了什么吗？

use.known: I didn't do anything special on Sunday so I stayed home.
use.target: 我星期天没做什么所以我在家。

use.known: She said she is going to be very busy this Sunday.
use.target: 她说她这个星期天要很忙。

use.known: If you have time on Sunday, we can go out together.
use.target: 如果你星期天有时间，我们可以一起出去。

use.known: I usually like to spend time with friends on Sunday.
use.target: 我通常喜欢星期天和朋友花时间。

use.known: Everyone wants to have a good time together on Sunday.
use.target: 大家都想星期天一起过得开心。

use.known: Did they tell you what they did together last Sunday?
use.target: 他们告诉你他们上星期天一起做了什么吗？

use.known: I didn't do anything special on Sunday because I was tired.
use.target: 我星期天没做什么因为我累了。

use.known: She told me she didn't have time to come this weekend.
use.target: 她告诉我她这个周末没有时间来。

use.known: If you didn't do the work, please tell me right now.
use.target: 如果你没做工作，请现在告诉我。

use.known: I didn't know they wanted to meet us on Saturday.
use.target: 我没知道他们想星期六见我们。

use.known: Everyone said they didn't see him at the office today.
use.target: 大家都说他们今天在办公室没见他。

use.known: Did you know I didn't go out on Saturday night?
use.target: 你知道我星期六晚上没出去吗？

use.known: I didn't do much on Sunday so I had a lot of free time.
use.target: 我星期天没做什么所以我有很多时间。

use.known: She asked what we need to do before the meeting starts.
use.target: 她问我们在开会开始之前需要做什么。

use.known: If you don't know what to do, just ask me for help.
use.target: 如果你不知道做什么，就问我帮忙。

use.known: I want to do something different this Sunday if I can.
use.target: 我想星期天做一些不一样的东西如果可以。

use.known: Everyone did their best to finish the work on time.
use.target: 大家都做得最好按时完成工作。

use.known: Did you do everything I asked you to do last Sunday?
use.target: 你做了我上星期天让你做的一切吗？

use.known: I didn't do much on Sunday but I had a good time.
use.target: 我星期天没做什么但是我过得开心。

use.known: She asked what we were doing at the office yesterday.
use.target: 她问我们昨天在办公室做什么。

use.known: If you don't know what to do, please ask me for help.
use.target: 如果你不知道做什么，请问我帮忙。

use.known: I want to know what you did last Sunday with friends.
use.target: 我想知道你上星期天和朋友做了什么。

use.known: Everyone is asking what went wrong at the meeting.
use.target: 大家都在问开会出了什么问题。

use.known: Did you know what he was trying to say to us?
use.target: 你知道他在试着和我们说什么吗？
